name: articulate-local
description: Local presentation-preference profile for Claude; same engine as Codex and Cursor packs.
long_description: Local activity imports, reviewed working preferences and shared MCP memory. Collection is explicit and on-device. Register each client locally and approve its separate sharing grant; imported raw activity is never returned through MCP. No Articulate cloud or learning-efficacy claim.

client_id.title: Registered client ID
client_id.description: Client ID returned by the trusted local activity client add command. Leave blank for legacy preference mode before enrollment.

client_token_file.title: Private client credential file
client_token_file.description: Absolute token-file path returned by local enrollment; choose the file without copying its contents.

data_dir.title: Activity data directory
data_dir.description: Absolute Articulate data directory used during enrollment. Blank uses the existing default local profile.
